top_signals.title: Strait of Hormuz ship traffic near three-month low as U.S.-Iran deal in doubt
top_signals.summary: Traffic is about 90% lower than the daily average of 130 ships that transited Hormuz before the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus makes first international flight — could COMAC challenge the aviation duopoly?
top_signals.summary: China’s C919 has made its first scheduled international commercial flight, a milestone in COMAC’s bid to challenge Boeing and Airbus globally.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin market in ‘hibernation’ as perp trading activity sinks to three-year low ahead of US CPI release: K33
top_signals.summary: Elevated open interest leaves the market exposed to sharper liquidation-driven moves, K33 said, as traders await Wednesday's U.S. CPI report.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
